message: Hey friends! As someone who loves to be ready for anything (yes, I might be the gloriously over-prepared one in my circle), I found this great resource on handling power outages. It’s packed with simple tips to keep your home cozy and your family safe when the lights go out. Remember, being prepared means you can focus on enjoying those candlelit moments instead of worrying! What’s your go-to tip for handling a blackout? 💡
